content.value_statement: Cloud storage code often fails under transient errors, large files, and costly list operations. This skill reviews Rust object_store usage and suggests safer patterns for production.
actual_capabilities: Detects missing retry configuration in Rust object_store builders.
Suggests structured error handling for storage reads and writes.
Recommends streaming and multipart upload patterns for large objects.
Reviews listing, prefix, and filtering patterns for cost and scale.
Guides environment-based cloud storage configuration without hardcoded credentials.
limitations: Does not run benchmarks or measure real cloud performance.
Does not validate live IAM, bucket policy, or provider configuration.
Focuses on Rust object_store usage, not every storage SDK.
Requires the user or agent to inspect code and apply changes.

use_cases.title: Harden data pipelines
use_cases.description: Review object_store reads, writes, and listings before production deployment.

use_cases.title: Reduce storage incidents
use_cases.description: Find missing retries, timeouts, and client reuse issues in cloud storage code.

use_cases.title: Improve code reviews
use_cases.description: Use a checklist for reliability, memory use, and credential handling in pull requests.

prompt_templates.title: Review basic storage code
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small Rust object_store function.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Rust object_store code for retry logic, error handling, and unsafe unwrap usage. Suggest clear fixes for production readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Check large file handling
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of upload and download paths.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this object_store upload and download flow for large file risks. Recommend streaming, multipart upload, and timeout improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Audit pipeline storage patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a data pipeline using cloud object storage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Rust data pipeline for object_store reliability, list efficiency, connection reuse, and credential handling. Prioritize issues by production risk.

prompt_templates.title: Design production storage access
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced architecture planning for S3, Azure Blob, or GCS.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a production object_store access layer for my Rust service. Include retries, error taxonomy, streaming, multipart uploads, tests, and operational safeguards.

output_examples.input: A Rust function downloads large Parquet files by loading each object fully into memory.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends streaming chunks, adding retry timeouts, and preserving useful error context for failed reads.

output_examples.input: A service lists an entire bucket and filters object names after collection.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests prefix-based listing, stream filtering, and bounded parallel processing to reduce cost and memory pressure.

output_examples.input: An upload path writes directly to the final object name and uses default client settings.
output_examples.output: The skill flags partial-write risk and recommends temporary paths, rename behavior, explicit timeouts, and reusable clients.

best_practices: Configure retries, timeouts, and connection reuse before deploying cloud storage code.
Stream large downloads and use multipart uploads for large writes.
Use prefixes, environment credentials, and clear error types for maintainable operations.
anti_patterns: Calling unwrap or expect on object storage operations.
Listing an entire bucket when a prefix can narrow results.
Hardcoding cloud credentials, regions, or bucket names in source code.

faq.question: What Rust crate does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on the object_store crate and common S3, Azure Blob, and Google Cloud Storage integrations.

faq.question: Can it change my code automatically?
faq.answer: It provides review guidance and suggested changes. The agent or user must apply edits in the project.

faq.question: Does it validate cloud credentials?
faq.answer: No. It recommends safer credential patterns but does not test live IAM, roles, or bucket policies.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when reviewing Rust code that uploads, downloads, lists, or configures cloud object storage.

faq.question: Does it cover performance concerns?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers streaming, multipart upload, connection pooling, prefix listing, and bounded parallel operations.

faq.question: Is it only for S3?
faq.answer: No. It also applies to Azure Blob and Google Cloud Storage when accessed through object_store.
